context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 287 fully tested. Four new modules added: (1) Developer Portal at /api/dev-portal/* with self-registration, OAuth app creation (hb_* client_id), API key generation (hbk_* prefix), revenue share opt-in, admin approve/suspend. (2) Wholesaler Network at /api/wholesaler/* with 5 providers (hotelbeds, tbo, travelgate, gta, mock), connection CRUD, test/push/dispatch operations. (3) Lead Funnel at /api/lead-funnel/* with concierge session ingestion, lead CRUD, status workflow. (4) Lighthouse Adapter at /api/lighthouse-adapter/* with mock compset data (5 competitors). Frontend panels: DevPortalAdminPanel, WholesalerHubPanel, LeadFunnelPanel. All Turkish UI throughout.
